Team was actively evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Private for real-time fraud reranking and support-chat fallback. They ran security questionnaire and flagged KMS and residency as requirements. - 2025-12-15: architecture workshop — SE (Ravi) mapped network/VPC constraints; Redwood Dedicated looked like a good fit.
- 2026-01-12: security review kickoff (fireflies ff_3691_2026-01-12). Sent Security FAQ and SOC2 evidence.
- 2026-01-25: pricing/commit proposal shared (drive pricing-deck-v2). Planned POC kickoff in Feb.

Notes from last call: "we love the throughput numbers but right now consolidating platform teams — can't commit headcount for POC."
Current status: stalled/closed-in-practice. No clear successor named; procurement has frozen Q2 budget for new vendor pilots. Security team had one outstanding ask around HSM/KMS integration and longer retention audits; not a deal-killer but adds friction.
Next steps (short): monitor org chart changes, wait for new payments leader, share lightweight hosted API pilot offer to keep momentum, set calendar reminder for re-engagement in May 2026.
Suggested playbook: reach out to ex-sponsor peers (Carla references) and to platform infra leadership; offer a low-friction hosted pilot with configurable residency to bypass immediate KMS procurement. If we can get a new champion, re-start POC with guaranteed rollback/fallback to hosted for first 2 weeks.
Key risks: no internal champion identified, long procurement cycle, potential shift to internal model or competitor (OpenAI/Anthropic) via existing cloud contracts.
